records.bodyText: {"model":"grok-4","input":[{"role":"system","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"You are Mixdog native web search.\nUse the hosted web_search tool for current or external facts.\nAnswer concisely, cite source URLs, and do not request local tools or file edits."}]},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"find x"}]}],"store":false,"include":["reasoning.encrypted_content"],"prompt_cache_key":"5c582f31-7664-484f-96df-856095a97d31","tools":[{"type":"web_search","filters":{"allowed_domains":["a.com","b.com"]}}],"parallel_tool_calls":true,"stream":true}

cryptoRandom.seedDerivation: one stream per product call site: fnv1a32(scenarioId) ^ fnv1a32(site) ^ 0x9e3779b9
cryptoRandom.note: only calls with a product frame on the stack; temp-file/lock names from shared/file-lock.mjs and shared/atomic-file.mjs are omitted (background cache writers, a race with the scenario window)

determinism.notRecorded: the local agent-trace flush timers (fire-and-forget; their presence in a scenario window is a race), delays of watchdog/deadline timers, timers created by Node internals (undici, ws, AbortSignal.timeout), and any wall-clock value
